Same person: L. K. Advani, Union Minister of Home Affairs 1998-03-19 to 2004-05-22 (identical office-with-dates). Neither id is in the inventory; the hyphenated-initials form used by union-home survives (recon notes).

Same person: P. Chidambaram, Union Home Minister 2008-11-30 to 2012-07-31 (the ngo fleet's wel:p-chidambaram record carries the same office and dates; money-people already used the wel: id). Inventory id survives; the force record is dropped and the id is referenced, not redefined.

Same body: the Government of Bihar (st br, ty state). The inventory has energy:govt-of-bihar (energy, ngo and finance fleets use it); the inventory id survives. state-police keeps its record under the energy id because it carries a force-specific fact. No other force:state-* id exists in the fleet (the other states are already energy:state-* / fin:state-* references).

Same body: the Government of Gujarat (st gj, ty state). The inventory has energy:govt-of-gujarat; the inventory id survives; state-police keeps its record under the energy id for its force-specific fact.

Same agency: the Intelligence Bureau (alias IB; reports to the Union Home Ministry). The inventory id ngo:intelligence-bureau survives (the task's rule: inventory id first); the union-home record keeps the force facts under the ngo id with the ngo fleet's ty/fam/st so the two fleets' copies agree. The critic's reverse direction (ngo → force) was not applied — see criticItems.

Same legal entity: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited, NSE: BHEL (the ticker in the force record) — the inventory's co:bhel (energy and finance fleets). Identified by exchange listing, not by name; inventory id survives.

refusedMerges.reason: The company (AgustaWestland International Ltd, Finmeccanica/Leonardo group) is a party; the case node is the court-and-investigation record. One is an actor, the other a mechanism; edges point at each.
AB Bofors (Kartongen Kemi Och Forvaltning AB) is the contracting company; force:case-bofors is the case record. Not one entity.
The registered co-operative housing society (respondent no. 4) vs the case record spanning the HC, SC, CAG and Commission.
Parent and joint venture: Dassault Reliance Aerospace Ltd is a separate Indian company (49%→51% Dassault); the own edges carry the link.
A joint venture is not its shareholder; Reliance Infrastructure holds its stake through Reliance Aerostructure Ltd (own edges procurement-industry:c052/c053).

Reliance Naval and Engineering Ltd (BSE 533107; formerly Pipavav/Reliance Defence & Engineering; now Swan Defence and Heavy Industries after the 2022 NCLT resolution) is one listed company, not the Anil Ambani group; a group is not its member.
Reliance Defence (money-people:c063/c066) belongs to the Anil Dhirubhai Ambani group, not to Reliance Industries Ltd; the name is shared, the companies are not (non-negotiable rule).

Subsidiary vs listed parent: MoD contracts are with Mahindra Defence Systems Ltd, the electoral bonds were bought by Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd (audit money-people:c020 item 7: keep separate, join by an own edge with its source).
Adani Defence & Aerospace is a subsidiary of Adani Enterprises (own edge procurement-industry:c046); a parent is not its subsidiary. Nor is either grp:adani.
PLR Systems is a 51% Adani Defence joint venture with Israel Weapon Industries (own edge procurement-industry:c047), a separate company and the vendor PIB names.
Tata Advanced Systems Ltd is one company of the Tata group (own edge procurement-industry:c049).
Economic Explosives Ltd is a 100% subsidiary of Solar Industries India Ltd (own edge procurement-industry:c048), not the listed parent.
A technical committee appointed and overseen by the Supreme Court is not the Court; its findings are its own (relayed by the bench).
Delhi trial courts (CMM, Special CBI Judge) are not the High Court; the Atlas court ids are reserved for the courts they name.

Different Singhs: Defence Minister 2001 (additional charge), Defence Minister from 2019, Prime Minister 2004–14 — identified by office-with-dates, never by surname.
The contract record (the 2016 IGA) vs the controversy/court record.
Four different CAG reports (2019 IAF capital acquisition; 2011 Adarsh; 2017 ammunition; 2007 Army procurement).
The Pegasus Project reporting (journalism of record) vs the class of writ petitioners who relied on it.
The class governed by the cooling-off rule (officers) vs all defence pensioners (all ranks and defence civilians).
The vendor vs the case record; NSO stays the producer node and asserts nothing.
Cochin Shipyard is a Central PSU under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, not a DPSU; its own edge now runs from the new min:ministry-of-ports-shipping-and-waterways node.
Five different shipyards; "shipyard" in a name is not identity.
